title: L0-LA59
description: L0-LA59—or Lola, as Princess Leia Organa calls her—is a friendly little Droid that is a constant companion to the precocious princess of Alderaan. Small enough to fit inside the 10-year-old girl's pocket, Lola can hover around and hop as well. She's a faithful Droid to Leia, but despite that well-programmed faith, she was put to use by the Inquisitorius when the Third Sister implanted a tracking device inside her. The tracker allowed Darth Vader to follow Leia and Obi-Wan Kenobi to the distant planet of Jabiim.
